title: Electronics
intro: Designing and simulating circuits, and how devices talk to each other.

items: Analog Design (#/electronics/analog-design): CMOS analog circuit design: devices, amplifiers, feedback, op amps, references, converters' building blocks, oscillators and PLLs.
Circuit Simulation with ngspice (#/electronics/ngspice): The open-source SPICE simulator from first netlist to Verilog-A models in .osdi files, mixed-signal simulation, scripting and Monte Carlo.
Communication Protocols (#/electronics/communication-protocols): How devices agree on wires, timing, framing and meaning to exchange information.
